pr.title: Label I don't understand without the item's kind
pr.head: f7551ec5bed6afe2560c1dfbbfda7e0b982bc542

summary: Projector's inbox panel sits above the Claude Code prompt and lists the questions, notices, and requests that agents post for you. Opening an item shows its drawer: the item's detail, any options, and a line of actions on the digits 6 to 9. The action on 6, I don't understand, tells the agent that posted the item that you don't follow it, so the agent rewrites the item in simpler terms.

Until this change that label named the item's kind, as I don't understand this question, this notice, or this request. The drawer already shows the item, so the kind added nothing. The label now reads I don't understand for every kind:

6: I don't understand
7: discuss question
8: dismiss question
9: snooze question
The other actions keep the kind, because dismiss question and dismiss request do different things. What a press does is unchanged: it still records the item as unclear, and the hotkey is still 6.

groups.title: The drawer's label and its tests
groups.kicker: One string in the panel, and the tests that compare it exactly
intro: The panel builds each drawer's action lines in hooks/register.tsx. The unclear line is the one change: its label drops this ${item.kind}. Its hotkey rule and its press handler are untouched.
The panel tests in hooks/panel.test.tsx compare each drawer's action lines with exact text, so every expectation that showed the old label now shows the new one.

checks.text: The tests catch the old label. With the old label put back in register.tsx, claude plugin test . fails 6 panel tests; at the head all 191 pass.

files.note: The unclear action's label is now a fixed string, and the comment above the actions says it is the one label that names no kind.

checks.text: The hotkey is still 6, and still left out when a stored item holds a choice on 6. The press still runs act with unclear, which passes the subject and detail the drawer shows, so a press on text the agent revised since records nothing.

files.note: Ten expectations of the drawer's action lines take the new label.

groups.title: The panel's documentation
groups.kicker: docs/plugins.md shows and describes the new label
intro: docs/plugins.md describes the panel. Its drawer example, its description of each kind's drawer, and its keyboard section now use the plain label. The keyboard section's rule that each label ends with what it acts on now names I don't understand as the one exception.

checks.text: No other code, test, tool description, docs/cli.md text, or AGENTS.md block template still reads I don't understand this. Only the completed inbox/unclear plan keeps the old wording, as its record.
